;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2016 Berlin truck attack]]
**[[Italy|Italian]] police arrest five [[Tunisia]]ns suspected of links to [[Anis Amri]], perpetrator of the December 2016 terror attack in [[Germany]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-security-arrests/italy-anti-terrorism-swoop-linked-to-berlin-truck-attacker-idUSKBN1H50TL (Reuters)]
*[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict|Terrorism in Israel]]
**The Central District Attorney’s Office filed an indictment with the [[State of Israel|Israeli]] Lod District Court against Abed al-Karim Adel Asi for the murder of a rabbi on February 5 and the Haifa District Attorney’s Office filed an indictment against Malek Yusef Nahar Asadi for the March 4 attempted murder by ramming a car which injured four people. [http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Indictment-filed-against-Ariel-terrorist-547450 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**U.S. District judge [[George B. Daniels]] of the [[United States District Court for the Southern District of New York|District Court for the Southern District of New York]] has rejected the government of [[Saudi Arabia]]’s request to throw out lawsuits claiming the nation helped plan the [[September 11 attacks]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/saudi-arabia-9-11-victims-lawsuit-us-court-allowed-twin-towers-terror-attack-september-a8279236.html (''The Independent'')]

;Business and economy
*[[United Kingdom|British]] [[automotive]] and [[aerospace]] engineering firm [[GKN]] (founded in 1759) is sold to [[United Kingdom|British]]-based investment company [[Melrose Industries]] for [[pound sterling|£]]8.1 billion. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-43584083 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 6.9 [[earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[New Britain Island]], [[Papua New Guinea]], at a depth of {{convert|35|km|mi|abbr=on}}. There are no reports of immediate damage. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-43592321 (BBC)
*A boat capsizes in [[Nawabshah]], [[Pakistan]], killing eight people.  [https://www.geo.tv/latest/188570-at-least-six-dead-as-boat-capsizes-in-nawabshah (Geo News)]
*A [[Línea Aérea Amaszonas]] passenger plane overruns the runway at [[Riberalta Airport]] after abandoning takeoff due to a [[bird strike]] and crashes into a ditch with no injuries. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4b6b04a9&opt=0 (''The Aviation Herald'')]
*The [[Bureau d'Enquêtes et d'Analyses pour la Sécurité de l'Aviation Civile]] completes its probe into the March 2016 near-miss between two commercial aircraft at [[Basel/Mulhouse Airport]], concluding miscommunication between an air crew and [[air traffic control]] was to blame. One aircraft took off over the top of the other one. [http://avherald.com/h?article=49578d24&opt=0 (''The Aviation Herald'')]

;International relations
*[[April 2018 inter-Korean summit|2018 inter-Korean summit]]
**Authorities announce that the summit between the governments of [[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] will take place on April 27, 2018. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/03/29/summit-north-south-korea-april-27/468580002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Reactions to the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]]
**The [[Vladimir Putin|Putin administration]] closes the [[United States]] consulate in [[Saint Petersburg]] and expels 60 U.S. diplomats from [[Russia]] as a retaliatory measure to the closing of the [[Russia]]n consulate in [[Seattle, Washington]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43590933 (BBC)]
*[[Poland in the European Union]]
**The [[Poland|Polish]] government announces a planned visit for April 9 from [[European Commission]] Vice President [[Frans Timmermans]]. The government of Poland and the [[European Union]] are locked in a dispute over planned judicial reforms. [https://sg.news.yahoo.com/eus-timmermans-visit-poland-over-court-reforms-201346522.html (AFP News via Yahoo)]
*[[American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]], during a speech on his [[Infrastructure-based development#Trump’s 'America First' Infrastructure Plan|infrastructure plan]] in [[Richland County, Ohio]], announces [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] will be leaving [[Syria]] "very soon."  [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/03/29/trump-syria-military-isis-491856 (Politico)] [http://www.whitehousedossier.com/2018/03/28/trump-schedule-thursday-march-29-2018/ (White House Dossier)]

;Law and crime
*[[2018 Valencia, Venezuela fire]]
**An attempted prison break and subsequent rioting and fires at a police station in [[Valencia, Carabobo|Valencia]], [[Carabobo State]], [[Venezuela]], results in at least 68 people dead. Two women who were visiting inmates are thought to be among the dead. Prosecutor General [[Tarek Saab]] says an investigation into what has happened would begin immediately. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-43579108 (BBC)]
*A [[France|French]] animal rights activist is charged under counterterror legislation for praising the death of a butcher in a terror attack. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/french-vegan-faces-terror-charge-over-dead-butcher-comment/ (The Times of Israel)]
*[[Extradition law in the United States]]
**[[United States Department of Justice|U.S. Department of Justice]] immigration Judge Jose A. Sanchez in [[Boston]], [[Massachusetts]], approves an extradition request from the government of [[Guatemala]] for Juan Alicio Samayoa Cabrera, who is wanted for trial for [[war crimes]]. [http://www.wbur.org/news/2017/12/21/alleged-war-criminal-samayoa-denied-bail (WBUR News)]
*[[Asylum in the United States]]
**Because the [[United States Department of Homeland Security|Department of Homeland Security]] (DHS) routinely failed to notify screened immigrant asylum-seekers of the one-year deadline for filing an actual asylum application, [[United States District Court for the Western District of Washington|Western Washington state]] chief [[United States federal judge|federal district judge]] [[Ricardo S. Martinez]] orders DHS to give those who missed the deadline another year to file their application, and to modify the DHS asylum system to avoid future problems. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/us-judge-opens-door-for-thousands-to-apply-for-asylum/2018/03/29/93720e20-33ae-11e8-b6bd-0084a1666987_story.html?utm_term=.752a54d11794 (AP via ''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**A pair of women accuse ''[[The Ren & Stimpy Show]]'' creator [[John Kricfalusi]] of sexually abusing them in the 1990s while they were minors. Kricfalusi, who was in his 40s at the time, admitted to [[Buzzfeed]] that he had an underage girlfriend during the years in question. [https://www.buzzfeed.com/arianelange/john-kricfalusi-ren-stimpy-underage-sexual-abuse?utm_term=.ogbENOXON#.fo8Nq9b9q (BuzzFeed)] 
*A car bomb kills five people and injures six others in [[Ajdabiya]], [[Libya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/at-least-5-killed-by-car-bomb-in-eastern-libya-medics-idUSKBN1H5359 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Egyptian presidential election, 2018]]
**State media reports preliminary indications incumbent President [[Abdul Fattah al-Sisi]] has won 90% of the vote with a 41% turnout. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-43581039 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Kentucky Senate Bill 151]]
**Lawmakers at the [[Kentucky Senate]] and the [[Kentucky House of Representatives]] pass a heavily disputed [[2018 Kentucky Senate Bill 151|pension overhaul]] and forward it to [[Governor of Kentucky|Governor]] [[Matt Bevin]] for his signature. Several [[List of school districts in Kentucky|school districts]] will close on Friday due to teacher protests against the bill. [https://apnews.com/article/b905ff9de20a42eda3d2d577ffdae9a0 (AP)] [https://www.wymt.com/content/news/Lawmakers-trying-to-push-pension-reform-through-at-11th-hour-478320433.html (WYMT-TV)] [https://www.courier-journal.com/story/news/education/2018/03/29/pension-bill-vote-fayette-county-public-schools-closed-friday/472024002/ (''The Courier-Journal'')]
